prompt: In the style of an oil painting, a long hospital corridor stretches into the distance, its walls painted a sterile cream. On the left stands a nurse in blue scrubs holding a clipboard. A brown dog lies on the floor next to the bench, resting its head on its paws. In the center of the hallway, a doctor in a white coat points toward a closed door at the far end. Beside the doctor stands a young boy in a striped shirt looking up at him. The doctor is looking at the young boy. A red fire extinguisher is mounted on the wall above them. To the right, a janitor pushes a gray mop bucket across the tiled floor. The janitor is sitting on the handle of the mop while pushing it. A potted fern sits on a small table next to the janitor. A man in a red scarf leans against the wall near the fern, checking his wristwatch. A silver wheelchair is parked empty next to the man in the red scarf. A child in a yellow raincoat stands beside the wheelchair, holding a teddy bear. The child in the yellow raincoat is looking at the teddy bear. A vending machine glows softly at the far right end of the hall. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. There is no emergency exit sign illuminated above any door.
